description: This PHP class 'LeaveCommentModel' represents a data model for leave comments in the OrangeHRM leave module API. It uses traits for serialization and constructs its fields based on a LeaveComment entity, likely for API responses.

classes.name: LeaveCommentModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing leave comment data, implementing the Normalizable interface, based on the LeaveComment entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a LeaveComment entity and sets up filters and attribute names for serialization.
